subject.title: Context breakdown can label virtual bootstrap files as 'undefined' instead of falling back to path/basename

question: Should maintainers review/adopt https://github.com/BingqingLyu/openclaw/pull/829, replace it with a narrow upstream PR, or keep waiting on the contributor?
rationale: The bug is source-proven and small, but the active candidate fix is outside the target repository with maintainer edits disabled, so automation should not queue duplicate work without maintainer direction.

options.title: Review or Adopt the Fork PR
options.body: If the patch still fits current main, review or adopt the external branch into openclaw/openclaw so this issue can close after merge.

options.title: Replace With Upstream PR
options.body: If the fork branch is not usable, create a focused upstream PR that only normalizes the shared label helper and adds regression coverage.

options.title: Wait for Contributor Refresh
options.body: Keep the issue open and leave the external fork PR as the active candidate if maintainers want the contributor to update it first.

recommendation.title: Review or Adopt the Fork PR
recommendation.body: If the patch still fits current main, review or adopt the external branch into openclaw/openclaw so this issue can close after merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Current blame points to this account's recent work on the checked-out shared helper and report path.
